scope: GF8 legacy-high AVX2 ordinary and one-item-batch encode at K=8, R=8, T=8, and 64-byte shards
implementation: Classify the exact GF8 legacy-high native-layout K=8/R=8/T=8 AVX2 codec once at creation without growing leo2_codec.
Recognize only dense packed 64-byte input and output slabs after scratch, metadata, range, and overlap validation completes.
Reuse the mature runtime-qualified ReedSolomonEncodeOneBlockT8 callback without adding a finite-field kernel.
Route ordinary encode and one-item encode_batch calls; sparse, detached, null, aliased, forced-transform, scalar, and all other shapes fall back unchanged.
Treat failed aggregate packed-range recognition as fallback rather than a definitive invalid argument so the mature per-shard validator retains authority.

authoritative_campaign.performance_statistic: geometric mean of one balanced log contrast per independent ABBA round with two-sided Student-t 95 percent confidence interval

target_result.interpretation: The promoted ordinary Leopard2 call takes about half the same-source general-path time and about 60 percent of exact Leopard main time.

credible_subthreshold_regressions.interpretation: This reproducible 0.41 percent same-text neighbor cost is retained and is below the two-percent promotion threshold.

covered_regions: K=8/R=7, K=7/R=8, and K=9/R=8 at 64 bytes

contract_cases: unaligned dense packed slabs and guard bytes
interior sparse output, all-null output, and detached fallback
undersized and misaligned scratch precedence and failure atomicity
input/output, output/output, metadata, and batch-descriptor overlap rejection
source immutability, forced-transform fallback, and scalar fallback
correctness_and_build_gates.independent_static_review: No release blocker remained after the aggregate-range fallback fix; the codec keeps its prior size and public ABI.

resource_policy.reason_for_less_than_host_parallelism: Builds and tests were serialized after prior session OOMs; cache-sensitive authoritative timing exclusively pinned CPU14 and reserved SMT sibling CPU30.

disposition: Promoted. The target credibly beats both same-source control and exact Leopard main, all parity and recovery digests match, correctness and sanitizer gates pass, and no measured neighbor violates the two-percent regression policy.
